text:
Ebe FIFA depụtara dị ka San Francisco Bay Area Stadium maka 2026 World Cup bụ Levi's Stadium, nke mepere na July 17, 2014 dị ka ụlọ nke San Francisco 49ers nke NFL. HNTB chepụtara ya, na-eje ozi dị ka onye na-ese ụkpụrụ na onye na-ese ụkpụrụ nke ndekọ, ma Turner Construction wuo ya na ihe dị ka $1.3 ijeri — ihe dị ka $1.2 ijeri site na ụfọdụ akụkọ.

Stadium ahụ nwetara aha ya site na Levi Strauss & Co., nke nwetara ikike ịkpọ aha na 2013. E wulitere ya maka bọọlụ America, ọ na-enye ikike oche nke 68,500, nke nwere ike ịgbasa ruo ihe dị ka 75,000 maka nnukwu mmemme. Maka 2026 World Cup, FIFA kwadoro ikike nhazi nke 68,827.

Site na afọ mbụ ya, Levi's Stadium guzobere onwe ya dị ka ebe maka nnukwu ihe omume karịa onye nwe NFL ya. Ọ nabatara Super Bowl 50 na February 2016 ma laghachi n'ọkwa ahụ na Super Bowl LX na February 2026. Oge ahụ hụkwara ya na-eme WrestleMania 31 na 2015 na College Football Playoff National Championship na 2019, na-egosi ọrụ ya dị ka ama ama egwuregwu dị iche iche.

N'ụzọ pụrụ iche maka stadium e wulitere maka NFL, ọ chịkọtara akụkọ bọọlụ ọkwa dị elu n'ezie tupu nhọrọ World Cup ya, na-adọta na nnukwu asọmpi mba ụwa emere n'elu ama ya.

Maka asọmpi 2026, a kpọgharịrị ebe ahụ nwa oge San Francisco Bay Area Stadium dị ka iwu FIFA nke ebe dị ọcha na aha na-anọpụ iche, nke na-ewepụ aha stadium azụmahịa n'oge asọmpi. World Cup na-egosikwa ihe dị iche na njirimara ụlọ ahụ: na 2026 Levi's Stadium bụ ebe mbụ na-anabata Super Bowl na egwuregwu FIFA World Cup n'otu afọ kalenda, njikọ nke ihe omume abụọ kachasị ukwuu nke ụwa egwuregwu n'okpuru otu ụlọ n'ime ọnwa ole na ole nke ibe ha.
